records.issue_text: absolutize_urls port handling is scheme-blind (adds any non-80/443 port regardless of scheme), and protocol-relative URLs in RSS content are left broken; spec only covers default-port case
records.rationale: `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls` builds `prefix` and appends `":#{uri.port}" if uri.port != 80 && uri.port != 443`, which is scheme-blind: e.g., an `http` URL on port 443 (or `https` on port 80) will incorrectly *not* include the port (see `prefix << ":#{uri.port}" if uri.port != 80 && uri.port != 443`). Also, it rewrites any `href/src` that `start_with?('/')`; protocol-relative URLs like `//cdn.example/x` match this and get rewritten to `#{prefix}/cdn.example/x`, which is incorrect. The spec only asserts conversion for a default-port host (`http://eviltrout.com/...`) and doesn’t cover non-default
records.stripped_text: absolutize_urls port handling is scheme-blind (adds any non-80/443 port regardless of scheme), and protocol-relative URLs in RSS content are left broken; spec only covers default-port case
